'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC male Gladiator in the [[Hunter's Den]] accompanying the Hunt with Augusta.
==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Igino''': Listen, my friend. Don't be fooled by this beast just because it has the familiar face of a Corrosaurus.
:'''Igino''': Tyrannos isn't just another wild stray. It's the most brutal, intelligent, and vicious of the lot.
:'''Igino''': It holds grudges. Remembers every wound and every face that made it bleed.
:'''Igino''': So take this seriously and be extra careful!
----
;(After {{Quest|By Sun's Burning Hand}}
:'''Igino''': Tyrannos was supposed to be the worst of it. Who knew there was something even more terrifying lurking behind it...
:'''Igino''': An enemy no one couldn't prepared for. That thing... it shouldn't even exist in this world!
:'''Igino''': Victory was ours in the end, but the cost was steep...
:'''Igino''': For a moment there, I thought we'd go down with the Sovereign.
:'''Igino''': But somehow... we made it out alive...
{{Dialogue End}}
